title: Weather App User can see a clear message when weather data can't be shown so that they understand why and what to do next

milestones.notes: Handoff comment posted on Plane WEATHER-5. 7 testable AC, size M. Depends on WEATHER-3; mutually exclusive with staleness by design.

Plan: split weatherClient's single generic error into 4 typed errors (NetworkError, ProviderUnreachableError, ProviderError, NoDataError); useCurrentConditions exposes a failureType alongside status; CurrentConditionsCard renders 4 distinct messages, reusing WEATHER-4's existing retry (refresh()/NEW OBS) — no new retry mechanism needed. Mutual exclusivity with staleness is already structural (failure only when no data exists at all); will verify with an explicit test rather than assume. Ledger created, 7 rows pending.

next_step: TDD loop: weatherClient.ts (typed errors), useCurrentConditions.ts (failureType), CurrentConditionsCard.tsx (4 distinct messages).
